issue.body:
**What.** Tasks 3, 6 and 7 of MODE_COUNT.md section 7. Task 6 stopped: the D 61 M = 48 background reached only |F| 2.7e-15 against 1e-15.

**Why.** Coverage of the one-unstable-mode claim at other D and resolutions.

**Found in sweep:** notes/MODE_COUNT.md section 7; hp/data/modecount_queue.log (task 6 exit 1).

**Acceptance (each can fail).**
- D = 4 seeding passes its pilot (|F| < 1e-20 at M 32, Delta within 1e-6 of 3.4454555) before the count.
- wind(g) not 0 in any box stops the run, and the finding is reported.
- Raw output goes to a task folder of the raw-data repository (AGENTS.md), and `python3 raw_check.py <folder> PATTERN` passes on it.

**Files.** [hp/modecount_local.sh](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/hp/modecount_local.sh), [notes/MODE_COUNT.md](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/notes/MODE_COUNT.md), [hp/data/modecount_queue.log](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/hp/data/modecount_queue.log)

**Commands (macm3, coordinator 2026-11-08), first jobs 7 and 6 with the cut.** The cut is explicit (`--kf=13`), as the job comments in `hp/modecount_local.sh` say. Output goes to the raw folder (`--data`), as in #69. From the repository root, 1 thread each, the two in parallel, nice 10. Raw folder `I70-macm3/`:
`python3 hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/states/up7_D45.0507.npz --M=48 --kf=13 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.056738610147195 --fmax=1e-15 --tag=D45.0507_M48_kf13 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I70-macm3/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I70-macm3/job7_D45_kf13.log 2>&1`
`python3 hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/seeds/local/up23_D61.0264.npz --M=48 --kf=13 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.043532530673195 --fmax=1e-15 --tag=D61.0264_M48_kf13 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I70-macm3/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I70-macm3/job6_D61_kf13.log 2>&1`

Stop conditions as in the body. A setup that raises on |F| > 1e-15 stops that job; report its |F|. wind(g) ≠ 0 in any box is a finding: stop and report. Job 3 (D = 4) comes after these two, by its own pilot. Report awake time beside wall time.

comments.body: started (jobs 7 and 6): macm3, main checkout at e04d6f17, venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, hpkernel 0.1.0 neon), the two `modecount_wind.py` lines as written with `--data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I70-macm3/data` (empty), 1 thread each, in parallel, nice 10, caffeinate -is, 08:56 UTC. What I know before they run: job 7 has no saved M 48 kf13 state, so it re-converges from the M 32 state, and job 6 resumes from the saved D 61 M 48 kf13 state, which sits at |F| 2.7118e-15, above the 1e-15 gate. A setup that raises stops that job, and I report its |F|. wind(g) not 0 in any box is a finding. `setup` saves re-converged states into `hp/data`, so those files are copied and the tracked one restored afterwards.

**Summary (macm3), jobs 7 and 6.** Job 7 (D 45.05, M 48 with the cut) converged and counted, with no extra zero in any of the 8 boxes. Job 6 (D 61.03) stopped at its gate: the setup raised with |F| = 2.7e-15 > 1e-15, as it did in October. Job 3 (D = 4) is not run, and the issue stays open for it.

| job | D | command (as written, `--data=<raw>/I70-macm3/data`, empty at the start) | exit | wall (awake) | setup \|F\| | determinants |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | 45.05 | `modecount_wind.py up7_D45.0507.npz --M=48 --kf=13 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.056738610147195 --fmax=1e-15 --tag=D45.0507_M48_kf13` | 0 | 2648 s (2648 s) | 3.3e-09 in the layout, 6.9e-13 after Newton, **2.0e-18** | 81 new, 25.7 s each |
| 6 | 61.03 | `modecount_wind.py seeds/local/up23_D61.0264.npz --M=48 --kf=13 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.043532530673195 --fmax=1e-15 --tag=D61.0264_M48_kf13` | **1** | 401 s (401 s) | **2.7e-15** in the layout, after Newton, and after Levenberg-Marquardt | none |

Both ran 1 thread each, in parallel, nice 10. No sleep (`awake.log`).

**Job 7: the boxes.** wind(g) is 0 in all 8 (printed +0.000000 or -0.000000), so no zero beyond the expected ones, and the winding of det M is what the expected zeros and candidate poles give:

| box | B0 | U0 | B1a | B1b | B1c | B1 | U | full |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| expected zeros inside | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 2 |
| candidate poles inside | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 7 | 14 |
| winding of det M | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 2 | -7 | -12 |
| winding of g | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The 8 boxes are the same as October's D 45 M 32 count (`hp/data/modecount_D45.0507_M32.log`, which also has the cut, by default for D >= 35): `boxes_D45_M48_vs_M32.txt`. Max phase step 0.379 rad. The extra pair of D 30 at M 48 is not here at D 45, with the cut.

**Job 6: the stop.** The saved state `modecount_state_D61.0264_M48_kf13.npz` sits at |F| 2.7118e-15. This run resumed from it, and Newton and Levenberg-Marquardt did not lower it: the state moved by at most 3.2e-11 and the stored |F| went from 2.7118e-15 to 2.6721e-15, with the gate at 1e-15. October's task 6 (`hp/data/modecount_queue.log`, the cloud, Linux) stopped the same way, from 1.3e-06 after Newton to 2.7e-15 after Levenberg-Marquardt and then the same RuntimeError. So this is a floor that two machines and two starting paths reach, not a failure to run. The kf13 floors at the three D are 8e-28 (D 30), 2.0e-18 (D 45) and 2.7e-15 (D 61).

I did not lower the gate or add `--allow_unraw` or any option, since a count on a state that does not solve its equations means nothing (the comment in `modecount_common.py`).

**hp/data.** Job 7 created `modecount_state_D45.0507_M48_kf13.npz` (copied to `hp_data_after_job7/` and moved out). Job 6 rewrote the tracked D 61 state (copied to `hp_data_after_job6/` with October's version, then restored). `hp/data` is clean.

**Acceptance (#70).**

| criterion | verdict |
|---|---|
| D = 4 passes its pilot before the count | not yet, job 3 is not run |
| wind(g) not 0 in any box stops the run | job 7: wind(g) is 0 in every box. Job 6 did not reach the count |
| raw folder passes `raw_check.py` | met |

Raw, choptuik-large-d-raw `I70-macm3/` at f739e9e (pushed through 4f4bf6f), with both logs, `.cmd` files, exits, `awake.log`, the 81-line cache in `data/`, `boxes_D45_M48_vs_M32.txt`, `job6_state_after_vs_october.txt`, `hp_data_after_job6/` and `hp_data_after_job7/`. `raw_check.py` over them exits 0. Main e04d6f17, venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, hpkernel 0.1.0 neon). I removed `running`, set the Status to Blocked pending job 3 and the decision on job 6, and leave the issue open.

### Recommended tasks

**1. Is job 6's 2.7e-15 a precision floor of the double-double residual?**
- What, evaluate |F| of the D 61 M 48 kf13 state in higher precision if the kernel has it at M 48 (AGENTS.md lists the octo-double residual as M = 32 only, so a quad-double one first), and with the state's two parts summed as the kernel does.
- Why, the floor rises from 8e-28 to 2e-18 to 2.7e-15 over D 30, 45, 61, and a floor from dd rounding would mean the state is fine and the gate asks for more than the arithmetic can give.
- Acceptance (can fail), the higher-precision |F| is reported next to 2.7e-15. A value far below it says the floor is arithmetic and the gate should be applied in the higher precision. A value near 2.7e-15 says the state does not solve the equations at M 48.
- Depends on #70.

**2. Job 6 at M 32, where the D 61 seed is native**
- What, the D 61 count at M 32 with the cut (the seed `up23_D61.0264.npz` is M 32 with |F| 3.8e-23, and `hp/data/modecount_D61.0264_M32.log` exists), re-run here with `--data` in a raw folder, to see the boxes this machine gives at the resolution that does converge.
- Why, the M 48 count at D 61 cannot run, and M 32 is the cross-resolution check there.
- Acceptance (can fail), the boxes equal October's M 32 log, or the difference is reported.
- Depends on #70.

$STATS

Coordinator: job 7 is noted, with no extra zero at D 45 with the cut. Job 6's floor is followed up in #159 (raise the cut at M 48: does |F| fall?), and the D 61 count goes to M 32 as #160. Job 3 (D = 4) waits until those end. #70 stays Blocked until then.

Coordinator: job 3 (D = 4) is unblocked. #159, #168, #170 and #178 found extra zeros only at M 48 with the cut raised to kf 21, never at the production layout. modecount_common applies the cut from D = 35 on, so D = 4 runs with the default layout, as job 3's command in hp/modecount_local.sh gives it (add `--data` to the raw folder). macm3 takes it after #184 and #179.

**Job 3 (D = 4) started** (macm3, 21:57 UTC), the coordinator's instruction: `running` label on, project Status In Progress. Apple M3, 24 GB, main 84d166fe, **venv-macm3-314: Python 3.14.3 (Homebrew), python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0**, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is. Raw folder `I70-macm3/job3/`, README with the gate written first: pilot `hp/modecount_lowD.py solver/data/neB_kc39_D4.0000.npy --kc=39 --M=32,48` must give |F| < 1e-20 at M 32 and Delta within 1e-6 of 3.4454555 before the count starts. Below D = 35 there is no default cut, so no `--kf`. One pre-step worth knowing: the `modecount_cx` extension built for Python 3.13 **segfaults under 3.14** (exit 139), so I rebuilt it with the 3.14 venv active (`hp/modecount_build.sh`, 32 s) and checked it with one D 61 M 32 determinant, bit-identical to I160's record (a changed lambda differs). The 3.13 copy is kept; the rebuilt `hp/modecount_cx/build/modecount_cx.so` serves 3.14 only, and any 3.13 run would need the saved one back. The old stale-wheel problem of #179 does not apply here.

## Job 3 (D = 4): stopped at its pilot gate (macm3, 22:03 UTC)

**Result.** The pilot fails its gate, so the count was not started. At M 32 |F| passes (1.7e-30 against 1e-20) but Δ misses by 3.5e-5 against the gate's 1e-6. At M 48 the Newton does not converge (|F| 1.3e-4 after 12 steps). The same numbers come out on Python 3.13.3, so the move to 3.14 is not the cause.

| | gate | 3.14.3 (venv-macm3-314) | 3.13.3 (venv-macm3, control) |
|---|---|---|---|
| M 32, \|F\| | < 1e-20 | **1.7e-30**, 5 Newton steps, 12 s | 1.7e-30, 13 s |
| M 32, Δ | within 1e-6 of 3.4454555 | 3.445490888642500, **3.54e-5 away: fails** | the same to every digit |
| M 48, \|F\| | (setup needs ≤ 1e-15) | **1.3e-04** after 12 steps, line-search steps 0.0625 to 0.5 | 1.3e-04 |
| M 48, Δ | | 3.445488723226338 | the same |

Every Newton line of the two runs is equal apart from the timings (`pilot_newton_diff_314_vs_313.txt` is empty), and the saved M 48 state arrays (zh, zl) are equal bit for bit. So this is a property of the pilot at this main, and 3.14 changes nothing in it.

**What the numbers mean.** `notes/LOW_D.md` has the validated Δ(4) = 3.4454524022410 (M 80; M 48 within 2.6e-7 of it; Martin-Garcia and Gundlach 3.445452402(3)). The M 32 value here is 3.85e-5 above it, the f64 seed's 3.4454555 is 3.1e-6 above it, and the notes put the echo's harmonic decay at D 4 at β = 0.157, slow enough that M 32 resolves Δ only to about 4e-5. So the gate's "within 1e-6 of 3.4454555" cannot hold at M 32 with a converged dd solution, and the M 48 step from the M 32 state is a resample that the Newton in `modecount_lowD.py` (it_max 12) does not carry to convergence. The count at D 4 needs a converged M 48 state, which this seeding does not produce. This is my reading of the numbers, not a test.

**Run.** `hp/modecount_lowD.py solver/data/neB_kc39_D4.0000.npy --kc=39 --M=32,48` as in job 3, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main 84d166fe, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0. Awake = wall in every window (`awake.log`): the pilot 124 s, the 3.13 control 129 s. Load average 2.0 to 2.3. The state the script saved (|F| 1.3e-4) is in `hp_data_after/`; `hp/data` is unchanged. No count was run.

**Three things I met on the way, all in the raw README.**
1. The `modecount_cx` extension built for Python 3.13 **segfaults under 3.14** (exit 139). Every mode-count script would have crashed on the new venv. I rebuilt it with the 3.14 venv active (`hp/modecount_build.sh`, 32 s) and checked it with one D 61 M 32 determinant, bit-identical to I160's record (a changed lambda differs). The 3.13 build is kept at `~/Source/hp-dist-stale-cp313/modecount_cx_cp313.so`; `hp/modecount_cx/build/modecount_cx.so` now serves 3.14 only, so a 3.13 run needs the saved one back. Like the wheel glob of #179, the build dir has one slot for all interpreters.
2. Pilot attempt 1 stopped at once with `No module named 'spec_long'`: the installed hpkernel finds the f64 solver through `$DSS_SOLVER_DIR`, else a path of the cloud machine. I set `DSS_SOLVER_DIR` to this checkout's `solver/`, the variable the driver documents. No code changed. No earlier macm3 task seeded from an f64 state.
3. The `modecount_lowD.py` run saved an unconverged M 48 state into `hp/data` without a warning beyond the Newton lines; I moved it out.

**Acceptance of #70 for this job.** "D = 4 seeding passes its pilot before the count": not met, stopped as the gate says. "wind(g) ≠ 0 stops the run": not reached. Raw: `I70-macm3/job3/` of the raw-data repository, commit 8d53791; `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

1. **Decide the pilot gate and the D = 4 seed.** What: replace the gate (Δ within 1e-6 of 3.4454524022, the validated value, at the M the count uses) and take the M 48 state from a converged one instead of the 12-step Newton of `modecount_lowD.py`: `hp/data/lowD_states/` already holds `lowDn_D4.0000_M48.npz` (and `lowD_D4.0000_M48.npz`, `lowDn_D4.0000_M64.npz`, `lowDn_D4.0000_M80.npz`, `lowDv_D4.0000_M64.npz`), the states behind LOW_D.md's D 4 validation and October's `modecount_test_D4.0000_M48` runs. I have not evaluated them. Why: this pilot fails identically on both Pythons, so it blocks job 3 whatever the interpreter. Acceptance: a D 4 state at M 48 with |F| < 1e-20 and Δ within 1e-6 of 3.4454524022 (the control: the present state, |F| 1.3e-4, fails), then job 3's count from it. Depends on: #70. Coordinator's decision, then macm3.
2. **Per-interpreter builds of `modecount_cx`** (one slot in `hp/modecount_cx/build/`), as for the wheel in #179. Acceptance: a 3.13 and a 3.14 venv each import their own build; the control is the 3.13 build under 3.14, which segfaults.

Coordinator, on job 3's stopped pilot.

- **The gate's reference was wrong.** It used 3.4454555. The validated value is Δ(4) = 3.4454524022410 (notes/LOW_D.md, M = 80), with M 48 differing by −2.6e-7 and M 64 by −1.8e-9. So the reseeded M 32 state's 3.54e-5 miss is the M 32 truncation, and M 48 does not converge from that seed.
- **Decision.** Count from the stored converged state hp/data/lowD_states/lowDn_D4.0000_M48.npz instead of reseeding. The gate: its Δ within 5e-7 of 3.4454524022410, which is M 48's truncation, and the setup's |F| ≤ 1e-15. If modecount_common cannot load that state's layout, stop and report; do not convert it.
- **Fixed on main.** modecount_lowD.py now defaults DSS_SOLVER_DIR to the checkout's solver/, and modecount_build.sh tags the module by interpreter ABI, so a cp313 build is never loaded by 3.14 (f1ea7cc).

**Job 3 count started from the stored state** (macm3, 22:09 UTC), the coordinator's decision on this issue: the pilot's reference 3.4454555 was wrong, the validated Δ(4) is 3.4454524022410. `running` on, Status In Progress. main f1ea7cc, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, in parallel with #190's kf 21 run (one thread each, load average 3.4). `modecount_cx` rebuilt with the ABI-tagged script (`modecount_cx.cpython-314-darwin.so`), smoke determinant bit-identical to I160's record, control differs. Command: `hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/lowD_states/lowDn_D4.0000_M48.npz --M=48 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.6740838 --fmax=1e-15 --tag=D4.0000_M48 --data=…/I70-macm3/job3/data`. The gate, written in the README before the run: Δ within 5e-7 of 3.4454524022410 and setup |F| ≤ 1e-15. **Both hold**: the stored state (D 4.0, M 48, 11 nodes 0.01 to 0.7, kt 36, kc 80, ks 200) has Δ = 3.4454526615874, 2.59e-7 above the validated value, and setup reports |F| = 3.8e-31, no re-converge, no state saved. modecount_common loaded the layout without conversion. wind(g) ≠ 0 in any resolved box stops the run as a finding. The number of determinants is not known yet (the notes guess about 80).

## Job 3 (D = 4): count done, wind(g) = 0 in all 8 boxes (macm3, 22:39 UTC)

**Result.** The D 4 count at M 48 from the stored converged state finds no extra zero: wind(g) is 0 in every box, all 14 edges resolve, and the real axis has only the two expected sign changes.

| box | wind(g) | wind det M | expected zeros | poles inside | max phase step |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0.097 |
| U0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.286 |
| B1a | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0.097 |
| B1b | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0.055 |
| B1c | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.115 |
| B1 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0.115 |
| U | 0 | -1 | 0 | 1 | 0.372 |
| full | 0 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 0.372 |

All edges verified with **0 mismatches**, at most 2 passes, largest step 0.372 rad (Im = y2, Re aR to aL), so U and full are counts. The sign of det M on the real axis changes only in (0.5, 1.0), the expected `lam_g` = 0.614, and in (2.5, 3.0), the expected `lam_phys` = 2.674.

**The gate (the coordinator's, written in the README before the run).** The stored state `hp/data/lowD_states/lowDn_D4.0000_M48.npz` (D 4.0, M 48, 11 nodes 0.01 to 0.7, kt 36, kc 80, ks 200) has Δ = 3.4454526615874, **2.59e-7 above the validated 3.4454524022410** (gate 5e-7: passed), and setup reports |F| = **3.8e-31** (gate 1e-15: passed). `modecount_common` loaded the layout without conversion; no state was re-converged or saved.

**Run.** The command as written, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main f1ea7cc, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), exit 0 at 22:37:29 UTC. 66 determinants (64 distinct points; two corners are evaluated twice and agree to the last digit) at 25.6 s each, 1736 s wall = **1736 s awake**, in parallel with #190's kf 21 run, one thread each. Pivot minima 2.0e-03 to 4.8e-03, far from the floors of the D 61 and D 45 kf 21 counts. `modecount_cx` was rebuilt with the ABI-tagged `hp/modecount_build.sh` of f1ea7cc (`modecount_cx.cpython-314-darwin.so`) and a determinant checked bit-identical to I160's record, its control differing. `hp/data` is unchanged by this count.

**Where #70 stands.** Jobs 7 and 3 are done (no extra zero at D 45 with the cut, #70 job 7; none at D 4 without one). Job 6 (D 61, M 48, kf 13) stopped on its setup gate (|F| 2.7e-15) and its question went to #159; it is not rerun here. I leave #70 open for you to close or to reassign job 6.

**Raw.** `I70-macm3/job3/` of the raw-data repository, commit 79387b9 (count_M48.log, the cache, exits.txt, awake.log, the pilot attempts and the 3.13 control from the earlier post, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

**Discrepancies.** None against the text.

### Recommended tasks

1. **A second resolution at D 4.** What: circles at the expected zeros and the strip (as #69's recount) at M 64 from `hp/data/lowD_states/lowDn_D4.0000_M64.npz` (the stored state next in the list), as MODE_COUNT.md section 7 task 3 asks. Why: M 48 is the only resolution of this count, and D 4 is where the notes expect the slowest harmonic decay. Acceptance: the windings equal the M 48 ones in each circle (the control: a circle around `lam_phys` 2.674 must give +1), and the setup |F| ≤ 1e-15. Depends on: #70.

Coordinator review. Job 3 is recorded in notes/MODE_COUNT.md §5 and §6 (this commit on main): D = 4 at M 48 has one unstable mode, wind(g) = 0 in all 8 boxes. Job 7 (D 45) was clean. Job 6's stop at D 61, M 48 was handled in #159, #168 and #178. All three of #70's tasks are therefore settled, and #70 closes. The recommended M 64 circles at D 4 are filed as a new task.
